versions.changelog: Switch source license to MIT-0 to match platform policy

Initial release of p2claw skill — share local apps via peer-to-peer URLs.

- Enables publishing local apps as public URLs accessible in any browser without cloud deployment or networking changes.
- Provides instructions for secure usage, including critical warnings about exposing local servers to the internet.
- Includes detailed prerequisites, installation (via bundled script), and setup checks to verify p2claw readiness.
- Explains how to start the p2claw agent (as a service or foreground) with user-friendly prompts and security reminders.
- Clarifies skill usage scenarios, recommendations, and operational hygiene for safe sharing.
